title: Осадный шар: вес, толпа и живые анимации
scope: Castle horse plus a crowd balloon: five crew + pilot, animated idle/pose, the whole balloon leans toward the shifted weight even parked, weight changes climb/turn/glide speed but never the altitude limit, visible gusts, live ropes, slower overheat; Space is the only vertical control, no anchor, no Shift, no height cap.
